liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **In The Pines** (2 reviews, 1 other source): Reviewer says this is the only time the band played this song; Paired with Cardboard Cowboy as a rare gem twin [2][7][14]
- **King Bee** (1 review): Described as a seething, muscular rendition [9]
- **Cardboard Cowboy** (1 review): Also appears as "Tastebud" in the 6/1/66 Scorpio Studio outtakes, and in the 7/29/66 PNE Garden Auditorium show [7]
- **Standing On The Corner** (1 review): Features one of Jerry's finest solos, according to the reviewer [14]

## Setlist highlights

- **Cream Puff War**: rare: 12 archived performances [16]
- **Stealin'**: rare: 14 archived performances [16]

## The recordings

- **gd66-07-17.sbd.miller.21064.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 7 songs; 34 min; rated 3.81/5 by 16 [1]. Said about its sound: Considering the 1966 date and short Fillmore sets, the listener finds this recording and the previous day's both great; Jerry's guitar tone comes across as snarling; reviewer sees it as a supplement to the GDLive copy; The downloadable soundboard sounds very good, better than many later soundboards [6][9][11]
- **gd1966-07-17.sbd.serafin.4458.shnf**: soundboard; 7 songs; 25 min; rated 4.75/5 by 8 [2]. Said about its sound: Instruments are crystal clear and well separated, with an active, moving bass line underneath; Uploader says many 1966-68 shows sound better than many 1970s reel-to-reel shows and early PCM ones [2][14]
- **gd1966-07-17.13959.serafin-marmar-sbefix-4458.flac16**: soundboard; 7 songs; 25 min; rated 3.5/5 by 6 [3]

## Around the show

- Reviewer attended on a friend's 17th birthday, having seen the band earlier that day in Golden Gate Park's Panhandle with Jefferson Airplane [15]
- Jefferson Airplane were setting up on stage while the Dead played [15]
- The 7/16/66 show is also on GDLive, with a different set list [10]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd66-07-17.sbd.miller.21064.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Soundboard [1]. Also: Listener got the show from GDLive.com, complete except the closing song, "He Was a Friend of Mine"; The full show is available at GDlive.com; the 7/16 show is recommended as well; The seller wrongly labeled the combined CD as from the Avalon Ballroom [1][6][7][8][10][12]
- **gd1966-07-17.sbd.serafin.4458.shnf**: transferred by Jay Serafin; source: SBD > RTR @ 15 I.p.s. > PCM > D > SSSB [2]
- **gd1966-07-17.13959.serafin-marmar-sbefix-4458.flac16**: transferred by sbe fix etc by Marmar of original Jay Serafin seed; source: SBD > RTR @ 15 I.p.s. > PCM > D > SSSB [3]. Also: Reviewer thinks Bear recorded the show [15]
